description: Ministry of Sports (Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency) - These Regulations may be cited as the Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No. 02 of 2016 - Deemed to have come into operation on 01/01/2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sport Act, No. 33 of 2013. It publishes the official prohibited list of substances and methods in sports, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements under the existing legislation. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it establishes binding rules and standards for anti-doping compliance.
